newsitem.title: FRANCE: INSTANT VIEW -French 96 GDP, Mar consumer spending.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW -French 96 GDP, Mar consumer spending.

text.p: Following are analysts' comments on the INSEE figures showing 1996 GDP growth revised up to 1.5 percent from 1.3 percent and also separate data showing consumer spending flat in March after a February fall of 1.3 percent.

This (1996 GDP figures) is more technical than anything else but it is encouraging, and the consumer figures suggest that the first quarter (of 1997) is going to be stronger than expected. Yes it's flat, but we had a strong number in January.
We're starting the year on a good footing. We may see better growth figures than the government has been suggesting so far.
